PM Modi urges teachers to curb screen time and address drug use

Prime Minister Narendra Modi met with 82 National Award-winning teachers on Teachers' Day 2026 in New Delhi. He advised teachers to curb students' excessive screen time by promoting sports, physical games and creative pursuits. Modi also urged teachers to raise awareness of drug addiction and to watch for signs of substance abuse among students. The Prime Minister highlighted the importance of teachers recognizing each child's strengths and building confidence for public speaking. The interaction was reported by multiple media outlets across the political spectrum.
